findings.title: Exact page-size multiples show a phantom page
findings.body: `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` reports one extra page whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the page size (for example, 50 members at a limit of 50 reports 2 pages). The UI then displays a nonexistent last page and allows navigation to an empty page. Compute the page count with ceiling division instead.

findings.title: Member offset can remain past the last valid page
findings.body: Clamping the offset to `user_count` still permits an offset that returns no members. For example, if a group has 51 members and its second page starts at offset 50, removing the sole member on that page leaves 50 members; the reload clamps to offset 50 and shows an empty page instead of returning to the first page. Clamp to the largest valid page-start offset (or reset the offset when it is no longer valid) before requesting members.
